sources.snippet: Whisper is a general-purpose speech recognition model. It is trained on a large dataset of diverse audio and is also a multitasking model that can perform multilingual speech recognition, speech translation, and language identification.

sources.title: whisper-tiny: Audio-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview whisper-tiny is a 39-parameter Transformer encoder-decoder model from openai trained for automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speech translation. Built on 680k hours of labeled speech data with large-scale weak supervision, the model generalizes across datasets and domains without fine-tuning. sources.title: Introducing Whisper - OpenAI
sources.snippet: We've trained and are open-sourcing a neural net called Whisper that approaches human level robustness and accuracy on English speech recognition.
